questions: Does the iteration 5 geometry score about 53.6 again, confirming the best result is repeatable and not seed noise?
Does the controller side clear the single line loss per run (line_loss_events 0), or does the loss persist with max_error at the floor?
Is progress limited by the controller (gain, line_loss behaviour, or base_speed) rather than by any geometry lever?

intent: Hold the best-scoring geometry (iteration 5) fixed as the platform for the controller. Geometry has no remaining lever that has moved max_error off the 0.06 m off-track floor or cleared the single line loss per run. The Robot Integrator should concentrate on the controller, and this design gives them a stable, well-characterised body and sensor bar to build on.
learning: Iterations 0 to 8 show that pitch, footprint (8 to 16 mm), track (0.10 to 0.12 m), mass (0.4 to 0.8 kg), wheel_radius (0.030 to 0.035 m), and lead (y 0.04 to 0.06 m) each leave max_error at the 0.06 m floor and one line loss per run. Geometry is effectively exhausted. The remaining gain is on the controller side, so the next iterations should test line_loss behaviour and gain rather than the body.
rationale: Iterations 0 to 8 (540 trials, all off_track) show a flat geometry response. max_error stays at the 0.060 to 0.068 m off-track floor, and line_loss_events is 1 per run from iteration 3 onward. Each geometry lever has now been tested: sensor pitch 10 to 20 mm, footprint 8 to 16 mm, track 0.10 to 0.12 m, mass 0.4 to 0.8 kg, wheel_radius 0.030 to 0.035 m, and lead y 0.04 to 0.06 m. The 8 mm footprint (iteration 8, 53.2129) was the last untested size and did not clear the line loss or lift progress, so it is not better. The off-track limit max(0.06, 0.0125 + body_width/4) stays at 0.06 m for every allowed body_width, so it cannot be raised. Scores fall within about 0.5 of each other, which is mostly noise. The best raced design is iteration 5 (53.6775): 0.016 m footprint, 20 mm pitch at y = 0.04 m, track 0.10 m, wheel_radius 0.03 m, and mass 0.4 kg. Progress (0.11 to 0.16) dominates the score, and no geometry change raised it. Under the rule set by my own earlier feedback, once line losses persist at 1 per run with max_error at the floor, geometry is exhausted. I therefore revert to the iteration 5 geometry as a stable platform, change nothing, and pass the remaining limit to the controller side. I expect a score near 53.6, consistent with iteration 5, and I expect max_error and line losses to stay at the floor.
